question.text: Which of the following sets of quantum numbers represents the $19^{\text {th }}$ electron of $\operatorname{Cr}(Z=24) ?$

solution.text:
Electronic configuration for $\operatorname{Cr}(24)$
$=\left[\mathrm{Ar}]_{18} 4 s^{1} 3 d^{3}\right.$
$\therefore 19^{\text {b }}$ electron enters in $4 s$ -orbital and its set of quantum numbers is $n=4, l=0, m=0, m_{x}=+\frac{1}{2}$
